name: flowspeech-tts
title: FlowSpeech TTS
description: Turn selected or copied text into natural speech with FlowSpeech
author: waeckerlinfederowicz66-sketch

commands.name: speak-selected
commands.title: Speak Selected Text
commands.description: Read the currently selected text with FlowSpeech

commands.name: speak-copied
commands.title: Speak Copied Text
commands.description: Read text from the clipboard with FlowSpeech

commands.name: show-recovery
commands.title: Show Speech Recovery
commands.description: Show saved request IDs without creating another recording

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: FlowSpeech API Key
preferences.description: Developer API key; generation requires active paid API access and consumes credits

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "This extension is published through the Raycast Store, not npm." && exit 1
scripts.test:build: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test/built-check.mjs
